fact: In March 2022 the Ministry of Territorial Administration and the ANICT stated they were supporting a taxpayer database for the regional and local development tax and market equipment in about 160 communes, and installing the ReCoDe software in 623 local authorities, with trainees from 84 Koulikoro communes.
title: Pour faciliter l'entrée des collectivités territoriales dans le numérique : L'ANICT et ReCoDe forment les délégués des 84 communes de la Région de Koulikoro
